summary: A Nano-Technician's gear is bought with one currency: NANO. Three stats do the work and all three are read straight from items.ocp here - NANO DAMAGE MULTIPLIER (Stat 0x218), a flat percentage on every nuke and DoT, which only 40 item names in the entire NT-wearable dump grant; NANO POINT COST (Stat 0x13E); and NANO C. INIT. (Stat 0x95). On top of that sits the item that defines the class: the CYBERDECK, a right-hand item locked to profession 11 that gives up to +100 to all six nano schools and sets every ranged weapon skill and ranged special to -2000. Wearing one is a decision to have no weapon at all. Every figure below is the QL300 (or top-QL) record for that exact item id.
_method: tools/eng-gear-extractor (--prof 11 --slug nanotechnician --wield) reads every ToWear/ToWield template in the OmniCell items.ocp pack (OMNICELL-CONTENT v3, client 18.8.50_EP1, 120,842 templates; 68,637 wearable, 61,507 of them usable by a Nano-Technician after applying the profession-lock rule) and emits each item's slot bitmask, ToWear criteria, profession lock, NODROP/Unique flags and worn stat bonuses. This file is generated from that dump by a script - no stat figure in it is typed by hand - and every id->name is re-verified against itemnames.sql. Items whose ToWear carries a Profession EqualTo lock that excludes NanoTechnician(11) are not in the dump at all.

cyberdeck.whatItIs: The Nano-Technician's profession item: a RIGHT-HAND (Weap_RightHand / LeftShoulder mesh) item locked to Profession EqualTo 11 and gated on Shadowlands (Expansion BitAnd bit 2). 97 templates across 11 names.
cyberdeck.theTradeoff: Every deck that grants anything sets Pistol, Rifle, Assault Rifle, Shotgun, MG/SMG, Ranged Energy, Bow, Grenade, Heavy Weapons, Burst, Fling Shot, Aimed Shot and Full Auto to -2000. That is not a penalty to work around - it makes every ranged weapon in the game unusable while the deck is worn. A deck NT is a pure caster with an empty weapon slot.
cyberdeck.breedAndSex: Each deck name exists once per breed+sex combination: Solitus and Nanomage share a template, Opifex has its own and Atrox has its own, each in male and female. That is why one name maps to 7 or 14 ids. ao-universe: "Right-click the one you buy and it will automatically adjust to one you can use."

notObtainableByNanoTechnician.why: These items carry NO profession lock on ToWear, so a criteria-only 'what can profession 11 equip' sweep reports every one of them as NT gear - and several of them top the Nano Damage Multiplier, nano-cost and Nano C. Init. rankings. They are META-PHYSICIST CREATIONS: the MP's 'Creation: <item>' nanos (FunctionType 53064 SpawnItem) conjure them, they are NODROP, and four of them additionally gate on NanoFocusLevel (Stat 0x163) BitAnd 64, a state that NO item in the entire 120,842 -template pack grants. nanotechnician-nanos.json contains ZERO SpawnItem nanos, so an NT can never create one. Every ranking in this file excludes them.
notObtainableByNanoTechnician.evidence: metaphysicist-nanos.json category 'Summon Weapon / Shield (Creation)' lists 20 'Creation: <name>' nanos; the names are matched against items.ocp to build this exclusion list at generation time, not typed by hand.

_deviations: THE SIGNATURE STAT IS NANO DAMAGE MULTIPLIER (0x218), not Heal Multiplier (0x217). It is the exact structural analogue of the stat doctor-gear.json is built around: a flat percentage on the thing the class exists to do, granted by only 40 item names in the whole profession-11 dump. The NT file therefore leads with it the way the Doctor file leads with Heal Multiplier, and it renders through the new generic gear.extraTables hook rather than the Doctor-specific healMultiplierItems block.

A WEAPON SLOT THAT HOLDS NO WEAPON. The Cyberdeck is the single largest deviation from every other class profile written so far. It is a right-hand item, locked to profession 11, that grants up to +100 to all six nano schools and sets 13 ranged weapon skills and ranged specials to -2000. No other profession has an item that takes its weapon away in exchange for casting power, so no template file has a block for it; this file adds one. It also means the NT's gear page and its weapons page describe two mutually exclusive builds.

ONE NAME, UP TO 14 ITEM IDS - AND IT IS THE NORM HERE, NOT THE EXCEPTION. Playbook §9b warns about 'Small Ebony Figurine' being nine templates. For the NT, EVERY Cyberdeck name is 7 or 14 templates, one per breed+sex combination. Every such row in this file carries templatesWithThisName + allIds and is read at a named id, so a reader who looks up the printed id finds the printed name.

COMBINED OFFICER'S, NOT COMBINED PARAMEDIC'S. The Doctor file picks Paramedic's because a Doctor buys survivability there. Read from items.ocp, Officer's gives an NT +180 to all six nano schools, +90 Max NCU, +1200 Max Nano, +300 Nano Pool and -18% nano cost, while Paramedic's gives no nano skill at all. Both are listed; Officer's is the pick, and Paramedic's is kept as the named survivability alternative.

MIY'S NANO IS DEMOTED, NOT PROMOTED. doctor-gear.json ranks Ofab above Miy's for a reason specific to the Doctor (it needs BM and MM specifically). For an NT the argument is stronger and runs the other way round: Miy's spreads ONE nano school per piece, which is exactly wrong for a class that casts out of all six. Combined Officer's gives all six on every piece.

THE PROFESSION NANODECK IS A SEPARATE ITEM FROM THE CYBERDECK AND THIS FILE SAYS SO LOUDLY. Two different NT-locked 'deck' families exist in items.ocp and confusing them would send a reader to the wrong quest: the Cyberdeck (right hand, level 50-200, bought from the Nano-Technician of IPS per Specialization) and the Profession Nanodeck (HUD, level 215, Dust Brigade quest reward, upgradeable to Activated and then Stellar).
NO PETS FILE. nanotechnician-pets.json is deliberately absent; 'nanotechnician' is already in the renderer's PETLESS list in tools/aodb/app.py, so the Pets tab says so correctly.

A CRITERIA-ONLY SWEEP LIES HERE, AND THIS FILE SAYS HOW. 23 templates that pass the profession filter are META-PHYSICIST CREATIONS (MP 'Creation: <item>' SpawnItem nanos) - NODROP items an NT cannot make, because nanotechnician-nanos.json contains no SpawnItem nano at all. Four of them also gate on NanoFocusLevel (0x163) BitAnd 64, a state no item in the pack grants. Unfiltered, Shield of Esa (275851) would have been printed as the NT's single best item in the game at +25% Nano Damage Multiplier - five times the next real one. They are excluded from every ranking and listed with their reason in notObtainableByNanoTechnician. No earlier class profile hit this trap because no earlier class's best-in-slot list collided with the MP's creation line.

THE COMPLETE PROFESSION-LOCKED CATALOG IS IN THE FILE. Per playbook §9, curated best-in-slot picks sit ON TOP of an exhaustive catalog: all 380 NanoTechnician-locked templates (125 distinct names) are enumerated in professionLockedCatalog, including the ones that are useless, so the list is complete rather than opinionated.

ONE ADDITIVE RENDERER CHANGE. tools/aodb/app.py's renderGearTab() gained a gear.extraTables loop at the very end. It renders only when a profile supplies the key, so no other class's gear tab changes and the Doctor's healMultiplierItems block is untouched. THE SERVER MUST BE RESTARTED for it to take effect (the owner runs port 8888).

'Ancient Cyberdeck' (302458) is in items.ocp with the same level-100 / Specialization-bit-2 gate as the Augmented Cyberdeck, but no allowed source names it. It may be a later re-skin, an event item or unused client data. Source recorded as unknown.
'Stripped Cyberdeck' (14 templates) and 'Stripped Basic Cyberdeck' (2) grant nothing and carry no level or Specialization gate. Their purpose is not established from the data.
The Cyberdeck credit prices (1/2/3/4 million) are quoted from ao-universe's Cyberdeck guide; prices are not in the client data and are not verifiable locally.

'Blackmane's Stat Buffer' (206704) grants +2,000,000 Max Health and +2000 to every skill including Nano C. Init. It is a developer/GM template, not a player item, and is deliberately EXCLUDED from every ranking in this file. It is the single biggest Nano C. Init. row in a naive sort of the dump.

150 templates in the profession-11 dump carry a 'HairTexture BitAnd 65536' entry in their ToWear requirement list - Combined Officer's Headwear (246670) is one. It is read faithfully and printed in the reqs string, but it is almost certainly the client's 'this headwear hides hair' rendering flag stored in the criteria block, not something a player must satisfy. Treat it as noise, not a requirement. Not verified either way.

This file does not rank implants or symbiants. Implants carry no profession lock at all (playbook §9b) and the NT's symbiant line is handled in nanotechnician-symbiants.json. Symbiant rows appear here only where they happened to top a stat ranking, and are marked by their own names.
